summary: The change adds the payee's full decrypted account number to the statement-delivery failure log. The process records are in order: approved ticket covering the component, independent approval on the head commit, and green CI on the head commit. AppLog masks account_number to the last four digits, so nothing shows LOG-1 is violated, but LOG-1 requires exhaustive evidence and the only control test is a sample that never runs the delivery-failure path; no test was added despite the PR's claim. Adequate evidence for LOG-1 can't be established, so the decision is HOLD until a test covers this error-path log entry (and the bank confirms that logging the masked last four digits is acceptable).
